title: Sound: import audio, attach to frame, emit DefineSound SWF tag
description: Sound workflow end-to-end: (1) File > Import > Import to Library imports MP3/WAV as a SoundItem; (2) Timeline > Properties for a keyframe allows selecting a library sound + sync mode (Event/Start/Stop/Stream); (3) SWF compiler emits DefineSound + StartSound tags for frame-attached sounds. The model already has SoundLinkage on Frame and SoundItem in Library. See docs/10-sound.md.
